headline: E. Stroudsburg go top after another away win
dek: E. Stroudsburg won at Millersville on Saturday and at West Chester on Wednesday, and lead the conference having yet to lose a match that counts towards the table. Across the whole season they have scored fifteen and conceded fifteen, and each of their three defeats came before conference play opened.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Millersville have scored more than West Chester and Pitt-Johnstown together, and the goals have come from six different players rather than a single forward: the spread of scorers, not one name, is what the chart is drawing.

wire.line: Millersville have scored 22 goals and conceded five, and still do not lead the table.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Shepherd's home match against District of Columbia is the one date on the record that has passed with no result, and it is Shepherd's alone.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Gannon have not lost since their opening match at home to Lake Erie, winning five and drawing one since, and have conceded nine goals all season.

findings.label: observed

last_match.line: E. Stroudsburg arrived having won at Millersville on Saturday; West Chester had yet to concede at home.

next_match.line: E. Stroudsburg have yet to lose in conference play; Shippensburg's only conference win came at home to Bloomsburg.
